drafted_from: tool row in tools/start-a-computer/tool-rows.json, do-work/start-a-computer.mjs (removeAPlace), do-work/rent-a-machine.mjs and tools/start-a-computer/test/start-a-computer.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Give back the computer in lease.json: I have moved its accounts to another computer."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads one lease file and removes only what that lease made.
instructions: 1. Confirm the computer holds no account that has not moved: this deletes a rented machine's disk.

2. Say the line in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:give-back-a-computer"} and runs node tools/start-a-computer/do-work/start-a-computer.mjs remove lease.json, with the machine credential on descriptor 3 and the DNS credential on descriptor 4 when the lease rented a machine or made a record.
3. Read {name, provider, state, adopted}. A machine you already run is only forgotten, never touched.

worked_examples.title: A machine the person already runs is forgotten, not touched
worked_examples.given: From tools/start-a-computer/test/start-a-computer.test.mjs ('an existing machine is adopted at its address and only forgotten on release'). lease.json = {"schema":"place-lease/1","provider":"existing-machine","name":"a-pi","state":"running","address":"192.0.2.40","adopted":true} with no DNS record, so no credential is read. Run: node tools/start-a-computer/do-work/start-a-computer.mjs remove lease.json
worked_examples.hands_back: {"name":"a-pi","provider":"existing-machine","state":"removed","adopted":true}: nothing was sent to the machine. For a rented Hetzner machine the name record is removed first, then the server and the SSH key, each only after reading it back and finding this lease's own label, and adopted is false.
